mapper.sql: select purchase_id, tenant_id, dept_id, period_id, purchase_no, customer_type, member_id, customer_id, customer_name, customer_phone, identity_mode, identity_confirmed, total_amount, paid_amount, receivable_amount, payment_status, delivery_status, order_status, idempotency_key from mem_purchase_order
mapper.select: where purchase_id = #{purchaseId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and dept_id = #{deptId} and del_flag = '0'
where purchase_id = #{purchaseId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and dept_id = #{deptId} and del_flag = '0' for update
where purchase_id = #{purchaseId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and dept_id = #{deptId} and del_flag = '0' for update

select item_id, purchase_id, tenant_id, dept_id, product_id, product_name_snapshot, policy_id, policy_version, package_id, package_name_snapshot, purchase_quantity, gift_quantity, total_quantity, delivered_quantity, delivered_sale_quantity, delivered_gift_quantity, remaining_quantity, unit_price, item_amount, policy_snapshot from mem_purchase_item where purchase_id = #{purchaseId} and del_flag = '0' order by item_id

select payment_id, purchase_id, tenant_id, dept_id, payment_no, payment_amount, payment_method, payment_date, operator_id, operator_name, status, idempotency_key, remark from mem_purchase_payment where purchase_id = #{purchaseId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and dept_id = #{deptId} order by payment_id

select delivery_id, purchase_id, item_id, tenant_id, dept_id, delivery_no, sale_delivery_quantity, gift_delivery_quantity, total_delivery_quantity, delivery_date, receiver_name, operator_id, operator_name, status, idempotency_key, remark from mem_purchase_delivery where purchase_id = #{purchaseId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and dept_id = #{deptId} order by delivery_id
mapper.insert: insert into mem_purchase_order (tenant_id, dept_id, period_id, purchase_no, customer_type, member_id, customer_id, customer_name, customer_phone, identity_mode, identity_confirmed, total_amount, paid_amount, receivable_amount, payment_status, delivery_status, order_status, idempotency_key, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark, purchase_date) values (#{tenantId}, #{deptId}, #{periodId}, #{purchaseNo}, #{customerType}, #{memberId}, #{customerId}, #{customerName}, #{customerPhone}, #{identityMode}, #{identityConfirmed}, #{totalAmount}, #{paidAmount}, #{receivableAmount}, #{paymentStatus}, #{deliveryStatus}, #{orderStatus}, #{idempotencyKey}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark}, #{purchaseDate})

insert into mem_purchase_item (purchase_id, tenant_id, dept_id, product_id, product_name_snapshot, policy_id, policy_version, package_id, package_name_snapshot, purchase_quantity, gift_quantity, total_quantity, delivered_quantity, delivered_sale_quantity, delivered_gift_quantity, remaining_quantity, unit_price, item_amount, policy_snapshot, del_flag, create_by, create_time) values (#{purchaseId}, #{tenantId}, #{deptId}, #{productId}, #{productNameSnapshot}, #{policyId}, #{policyVersion}, #{packageId}, #{packageNameSnapshot}, #{purchaseQuantity}, #{giftQuantity}, #{totalQuantity}, #{deliveredQuantity}, #{deliveredSaleQuantity}, #{deliveredGiftQuantity}, #{remainingQuantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{itemAmount}, #{policySnapshot}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update mem_purchase_order set customer_name = #{customerName}, customer_phone = #{customerPhone}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where purchase_id = #{purchaseId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and dept_id = #{deptId} and order_status <> '4' and del_flag = '0'

update mem_purchase_item set purchase_quantity = #{purchaseQuantity}, gift_quantity = #{giftQuantity}, total_quantity = #{totalQuantity}, remaining_quantity = #{remainingQuantity}, unit_price = #{unitPrice}, item_amount = #{itemAmount}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where item_id = #{itemId} and purchase_id = #{purchaseId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and dept_id = #{deptId} and del_flag = '0'

update mem_purchase_order set total_amount = #{totalAmount}, receivable_amount = #{totalAmount} - paid_amount, payment_status = case when paid_amount = 0 then '0' when paid_amount = #{totalAmount} then '2' else '1' end, update_time = sysdate() where purchase_id = #{purchaseId} and del_flag = '0' and order_status <> '4'
mapper.insert: insert into mem_purchase_payment (purchase_id, tenant_id, dept_id, payment_no, payment_amount, payment_method, payment_date, operator_id, operator_name, status, idempotency_key, create_time, remark) values (#{purchaseId}, #{tenantId}, #{deptId}, #{paymentNo}, #{paymentAmount}, #{paymentMethod}, #{paymentDate}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, '1', #{idempotencyKey}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.select: select payment_id, purchase_id, tenant_id, dept_id, payment_no, payment_amount, payment_method, payment_date, operator_id, operator_name, status, idempotency_key, remark from mem_purchase_payment where payment_id = #{paymentId} and purchase_id = #{purchaseId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and dept_id = #{deptId} and status = '1' for update
mapper.update: update mem_purchase_order set paid_amount = #{paidAmount}, receivable_amount = #{receivableAmount}, payment_status = #{paymentStatus}, update_time = sysdate() where purchase_id = #{purchaseId} and del_flag = '0'

update mem_purchase_order set customer_type = #{customerType}, member_id = #{memberId}, customer_name = #{customerName}, customer_phone = #{customerPhone}, identity_mode = #{identityMode}, identity_confirmed = #{identityConfirmed}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where purchase_id = #{purchaseId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and dept_id = #{deptId} and del_flag = '0' and order_status <> '4' and member_id is null
mapper.select: select item_id, purchase_id, tenant_id, dept_id, product_id, product_name_snapshot, policy_id, policy_version, package_id, package_name_snapshot, purchase_quantity, gift_quantity, total_quantity, delivered_quantity, delivered_sale_quantity, delivered_gift_quantity, remaining_quantity, unit_price, item_amount, policy_snapshot from mem_purchase_item where item_id = #{itemId} and purchase_id = #{purchaseId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and dept_id = #{deptId} and del_flag = '0' for update
mapper.insert: insert into mem_purchase_delivery (purchase_id, item_id, tenant_id, dept_id, delivery_no, sale_delivery_quantity, gift_delivery_quantity, total_delivery_quantity, delivery_date, receiver_name, operator_id, operator_name, status, idempotency_key, create_time, remark) values (#{purchaseId}, #{itemId}, #{tenantId}, #{deptId}, #{deliveryNo}, #{saleDeliveryQuantity}, #{giftDeliveryQuantity}, #{totalDeliveryQuantity}, #{deliveryDate}, #{receiverName}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, '1', #{idempotencyKey}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.select: select delivery_id, purchase_id, item_id, tenant_id, dept_id, delivery_no, sale_delivery_quantity, gift_delivery_quantity, total_delivery_quantity, delivery_date, receiver_name, operator_id, operator_name, status, idempotency_key, remark from mem_purchase_delivery where delivery_id = #{deliveryId} and purchase_id = #{purchaseId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and dept_id = #{deptId} and status = '1' for update
mapper.update: update mem_purchase_delivery set sale_delivery_quantity = #{saleDeliveryQuantity}, gift_delivery_quantity = #{giftDeliveryQuantity}, total_delivery_quantity = #{totalDeliveryQuantity}, delivery_date = #{deliveryDate}, receiver_name = #{receiverName}, remark = #{remark} where delivery_id = #{deliveryId} and purchase_id = #{purchaseId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and dept_id = #{deptId} and status = '1'

update mem_purchase_item set delivered_quantity = #{deliveredQuantity}, delivered_sale_quantity = #{deliveredSaleQuantity}, delivered_gift_quantity = #{deliveredGiftQuantity}, remaining_quantity = #{remainingQuantity}, update_time = sysdate() where item_id = #{itemId} and del_flag = '0'

update mem_purchase_order set delivery_status = case when not exists ( select 1 from mem_purchase_item where purchase_id = #{purchaseId} and del_flag = '0' and remaining_quantity > 0 ) then '2' when exists ( select 1 from mem_purchase_item where purchase_id = #{purchaseId} and del_flag = '0' and delivered_quantity > 0 ) then '1' else '0' end, update_time = sysdate() where purchase_id = #{purchaseId} and del_flag = '0'

update mem_purchase_order set total_amount = #{totalAmount}, paid_amount = #{paidAmount}, receivable_amount = #{totalAmount} - #{paidAmount}, payment_status = #{paymentStatus}, update_time = sysdate() where purchase_id = #{purchaseId} and del_flag = '0' and order_status <> '4'
